ask: Does this look right to you, so I can mark the pull request ready?
problem: Organizations fear being locked in. Admins could not take out recordings, their details, and the full history together.
found: Reports already exist, but only counts. Nothing gathered the audio, who made it, and the raw history. A server job can do that without a phone.
changed: Org admins on the web see Export all data. They pick all languages or some. A server job makes one zip. They watch progress, then download.
why: A zip of many recordings is too big for the web server. A job has the memory and time. The zip waits seven days. Only the org admin can ask.
touches: Adds a request table and a server job. The format is written in the docs, with a decision entry. Phones do not show it. USB backup is untouched.
